verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes ReadMe publishing its own MCP server so external AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code Copilot) can call ReadMe's API/docs tools (readme-docs-3, readme-docs-34, readme-probe-2) — this is the server role, the opposite of what the story asks. There is no evidence that ReadMe's own AI features (Ask AI, AI Agent, GitHub AI Writer) can connect to and consume external MCP servers as a client.
